fusions.name: Silt-Hidden Edge
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A blade of pressed water deals 20 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet bled.

fusions.name: Thrown Slivers
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws 3 slivers of pressed water, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Murk
fusions.desc: Veils you in murky water for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Bloodied Rill
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
